headline: Application role would gain unrestricted access to all S3 buckets, not just reporting ones

findings.evidence_ref: Default changed from `["arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data", "arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*"]` to `["*"]` in variables.tf
findings.explanation: The application role will now have read and write permissions on every S3 bucket in the account, far beyond the stated intent of accessing "reporting buckets". This grants access to customer data, credentials, backups, and other sensitive storage.
